name: CMExam
description: CMExam is a comprehensive Chinese medical exam dataset sourced from the Chinese National Medical Licensing Examination. It contains over 60K multiple-choice questions with solution explanations for evaluating large language models in medical question answering and reasoning, along with detailed medical annotations such as disease groups and question difficulty.
reputation: First Chinese medical exam dataset with comprehensive medical annotations; used for evaluating LLMs in Chinese medical QA.
notes: Includes five additional question-wise annotations by medical professionals; highlights gap between LLM and human performance.
